name: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited
summary: AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited manufactures and sells aircraft equipment, aviation component, and intelligent measurement and control products in China and internationally. It offers motor vehicle inspection equipment; sensors and instruments; and weighing control systems. The company also engages in the research and experimental development activities. In addition, it provides military and civil aviation, as well as non-aviation products. The company was formerly known as Zhonghang Electronic Measuring Instruments Co.,Ltd and changed its name to AVIC Chengdu Aircraft Company Limited in January 2025.
